agyos_skill.intent: Use Supabase-maintained Postgres guidance for query, schema, indexing, connection, concurrency, and row-level security reviews in Supabase or Postgres projects.
agyos_skill.instructions: Comprehensive performance optimization guide for Postgres, maintained by Supabase. Contains rules across 8 categories, prioritized by impact to guide automated query optimization and schema design.
